title: 第3章 技能活化
content_zh:
去厨房的路上，老弟魏歌辞嘤的一声表示哥，我升级了。

    其实不用老弟提醒，魏乐府他也知道，毕竟老弟是他的伴生元灵。

    他一边确定老弟的情况，一边打开了面板。

    随着老弟的升级，他也拥有了对应的面板。

    【伴生灵体：魏歌辞】

    【天数：道化（可与伴生者所替代身份的一个技能融合并替代该技能成为技能元灵，每个身份仅可选择1个技能，选择后无法更换，回归后取消技能元灵形态。）】

    【神通：造化（在技能元灵形态下，自动提升被融合替代的技能等级。）】

    【法术：诸界（将伴生者所替代身份的一项完整的技能预设到技能栏，回归后一同带回并适配为法术提供于伴生者本体，当前技能栏：0/1。）】

    相较于魏乐府，魏歌辞的面板没有名牒，也少了位次和精气神三个属性。

    但是他和魏乐府一样拥有天数、神通以及法术。

    只是这些能力大概率不是他原本拥有的，而是在成为魏乐府的伴生灵体后被转化了。

    此前，魏乐府一直不知道自己为何会被世界排到天榜第三名。

    虽然他老弟是天级资质，可这和他一个地级有什么关系，更别说他老弟人都没了，就只剩下个灵体。

    原来需要适配他的天数，才能真正发挥出天级的强度。

    就是限制比较大，必须是被替代者的技能才行，并且每个身份只能选择一个技能。

    以后新身份选技能就得谨慎一点了。

    至于丁守成这个身份不需要，因为这个世界的武学都是大差不差，没有多少高下之分。

    重楼功锻体魄生气血，宝塔桩则是滋养气血，这分别是练法和养法。

    明堂劲是以劲力招式搬运气血的打法。

    基础就是重楼功了，少了它，后面的养法和打法都废了。

    既然武学没有区别，那肯定选重楼功这个基础了。

    与其想什么神功秘籍，还不如在这个低武世界想想怎么吃好。

    穷文富武可不是随便说说的，吃得好才是关键。
content_en:
On the way to the kitchen, my brother Wei Ge said with a sigh, "Brother, I have been upgraded."

    In fact, he doesn't need to remind him, he also knows about Wei Yuefu, after all, he is his companion Yuanling.

    While confirming his brother's condition, he opened the panel.

    As my brother upgraded, he also had the corresponding panel.

    [Accompanied Spirit: Wei Ge Ci]

    [Number of days: Daohua (can be fused with a skill of the identity replaced by the companion and replace the skill to become a skill Yuanling. Each identity can only choose 1 skill. It cannot be changed after selection. The skill Yuanling form is canceled after returning.)]

    [Supernatural power: Creation (In the skill elemental form, the level of the skill replaced by fusion is automatically increased.)]

    [Spell: All Realms (Preset a complete skill of the identity replaced by the companion into the skill column. After returning, bring it back together and adapt it as a spell to the companion body. Current skill column: 0/1.)]

    Compared with Wei Yuefu, Wei Geci's panel does not have a name ultimatum, and it also lacks the three attributes of rank and spirit.

    But like Wei Yuefu, he has heaven, magical powers and magic.

    It's just that these abilities are most likely not what he originally possessed, but were transformed after becoming Wei Yuefu's companion spirit.

    Previously, Wei Yuefu never knew why he was ranked third on the world rankings.

    Although his brother has heaven-level qualifications, what does this have to do with him being an earth-level person? Not to mention that his brother is gone and only a spirit body is left.

    It turns out that he needs to adapt to his days in order to truly exert his heaven-level strength.

    The restriction is relatively large, it must be the skill of the person being replaced, and each identity can only choose one skill.

    From now on, you have to be more careful when choosing skills for a new identity.

    As for Ding Shoucheng's identity, there is no need for it, because the martial arts in this world are all about the same, and there is not much distinction between superior and inferior.

    The Chonglou Kung Fu exercises the body's vitality and blood, while the Pagoda Post nourishes the Qi and blood. These are training methods and nourishing methods respectively.

    Mingtang Jin is a style of play that uses powerful moves to transfer energy and blood.

    The foundation is Chonglou Gong. Without it, the subsequent cultivation and fighting methods will be useless.

    Since there is no difference in martial arts, the foundation of Chonglou Gong must be chosen.

    Instead of thinking about magical secrets, it is better to think about how to eat well in this low-martial world.

    Being poor in culture and rich in military affairs is not just something you say casually. Eating well is the key.
